messages:
Mike (Sales): quick sync — ACME wants a 3-week POC. Needs chat summarization + relevance reranking for search results. They asked about streaming, auth, and cost. Who owns final scope?
Sara (PM): I'm driving scope. Proposed success criteria: 1) summary quality >= baseline on their 200 prompt eval set, 2) p95 latency < 300ms for single-turn queries, 3) rerank precision@5 >= 0.8, 4) integration demo with streaming UI. Timeline: week1 integration + auth, week2 evals and tuning, week3 demo + handoff.
Mike (Sales): sounds good. ACME also flagged enterprise legal items (data retention, KMS). Anya, can you confirm what we can commit for POC?
Anya (Security): for POC we can offer: short-term logs retention (30 days), BYOK via customer KMS for Private/Dedicated - but hosted will use our KMS. Need their legal to sign standard DPA. Also ask them for IP ranges if they want allowlist. Will need answers on: data exfil, model telemetry, employee access.
Olga (Solutions Eng): integration notes: recommend using JS SDK streaming for the demo. For server-to-server auth use API key with OAuth optional. We should give them a scoped API key with read/write limits. Also provide a quickstart repo.
Jon (Eng): implementation details: streaming + resumability supported. Example client snippet to stream chat (JS):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'rwd-3-small', input: prompt });
for await (const chunk of stream) { console.log(chunk.delta); }
```
Jon (Eng): retry guidance: client-side exponential backoff (base 200ms, max 5s), idempotency keys for mutating ops (uploads). For rate limits, we can set a per-key qpm and tokens/minute. For POC propose 200 qpm burstable to 500 for demo.
Mike (Sales): pricing question — they asked price for 3-week POC and options if they convert. Suggestion?
Sara (PM): offer: free dev credits for POC up to $3k usage, and if they convert to Dedicated we can discount first 3 months or credit against committed spend. Keep this as presales offer; legal to finalize.
Olga (Solutions Eng): operational checklist for them to integrate: 1) add API key to secret manager, 2) open outbound port 443 to our endpoints, 3) configure CORS if calling from browser demo, 4) supply eval prompts and relevance labels (CSV).
Anya (Security): also request their SOC2 report and completed security questionnaire. If they want VPC/private, we need a contact for engineering to schedule a network runbook — add at least 5 business days.
Mike (Sales): enterprise blocker: their infra team insists on mutual TLS for server-to-server. Can Redwood support mTLS for hosted?
Jon (Eng): hosted doesn't support customer mTLS today. Options: 1) use Dedicated or Private (both support customer certs), 2) set up IP allowlist + VPN to meet their requirement temporarily. We can escalate if they require hosted with mTLS.
Olga (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the POC integration README and a stripped-down quickstart app they can fork. Will include sample eval harness and instructions to upload labels.
Sara (PM): next steps: Olga to share README + quickstart by EOD tomorrow, Jon to provide final SDK snippet and recommended retry/rate config, Anya to send required security docs checklist, Mike to coordinate contract/DPA.
Mike (Sales): thanks all — I'll ping ACME with timeline + ask for eval dataset and security contacts. @Olga @Anya @Jon please flag if any timeline conflicts. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: scheduled-demo: reminder — demo environment will be provisioned on 1759580000 (approx).
